question: What will be the maximum intraday value of the VIX over these biweekly periods in Q4 2026? (Nov 23 - Dec 4)

calls.reasoning: Cboe CSV: VIX closed Nov 20, 2026 at 35.89 after an intraday high of 40.03 on an AI/tech selloff (Nasdaq -5.3%, S&P in correction, fears of a December Fed hike). It is the third escalating spike in a month (Oct 30 high 23.9, Nov 5 high 28.4). Past spike-close cases (Aug 2015, Dec 2018, Aug 2024, Apr 2025) put the next-9-day max at 0.90-1.00x the close; the regime-break cases (Feb 2018, Feb 2020) reached 1.35-1.6x. December VIX futures at 28.87 (backwardation) and the roughly +1.4% weekend Nasdaq proxy point to mean reversion, so the Monday high is likely 32-35. The window has 9 trading days (Thanksgiving off), and the jobs report on Dec 4 is the last catalyst inside it. Odds of beating Friday's 40.03 are about 25-30%; tail above 50 about 5%. No human prediction market found on Kalshi, Polymarket, Manifold or bookmakers.
